entries.summary: Owner status shortcode now shows plain-English labels instead of raw status strings
entries.notes: Map: in_review=Under Review, verified=Verified, completed=Certificate Ready. Unknown statuses fall back to ucwords.

entries.summary: No-submission message now includes the active award year for context
entries.notes: Was: No award submission found. Now: No submissions found for the 2026 haunt award season.

entries.summary: Added Most Outstanding Haunted Campsite award category with [oha_campsite_award_submit] shortcode
entries.notes: New class-campsite-form.php. Open to non-logged-in submitters. Fields: campground name, location, contact name/email, description, optional photo. Stamps _oha_award_type=campsite and _oha_award_year on every entry. Uses same CPT, status flow, year isolation, and cert workflow as actor awards.

entries.summary: Campsite award has its own independent open/close, bypass token, and email settings in Awards > Settings
entries.notes: is_submissions_open() now accepts a  param (actor or campsite). Campsite section added to register() with its own fields. Does not share toggle/date/token with actor award.

entries.summary: Admin table now has Type column and Type filter (All / Haunt Actor / Campsite)
entries.notes: get_view_type() added. prepare_items() and export_csv() both respect type filter. Actor filter includes legacy entries with no _oha_award_type meta (NOT EXISTS OR actor). Column methods (haunt_name, owner, actor_name, character_name, reason) are all type-aware.

entries.summary: CSV export now correctly reads the year filter
entries.notes: get_view_year() previously only checked  but the export form POSTs the year. Now checks  as fallback. Same fix applied to type filter via get_view_type().

entries.summary: Email templates are type-aware - campsite entries use campsite-specific templates and placeholders
entries.notes: build_replacements() adds {campground_name}, {contact_name}, {contact_email}, {location}, {award_type}. send_cert_ready, send_admin_notice, and send_submitter_confirm all check _oha_award_type and select the right template.

entries.summary: Owner dashboard [oha_awards] shows type badge and type-appropriate fields per entry
entries.notes: Red badge for Haunt Actor, blue for Campsite. Campsite cards show campground name and location instead of actor name.

entries.summary: Replace check_admin_referer with wp_verify_nonce to prevent wp_die on nonce failure
entries.notes: check_admin_referer calls wp_die if nonce is missing or expired - bots/crawlers hitting admin-post.php triggered this and the error page got cached site-wide causing white screen. Now redirects back to referer or home_url on failure.

entries.summary: Replace wp_die on missing required fields with redirect in campsite form handler
entries.notes: Avoids any wp_die call path in handle_submit - redirects with oha_campsite_error=1 param instead.

entries.summary: Replace all smart/curly quotes with ASCII straight quotes in class-email.php and class-settings.php
entries.notes: LLM generated code with Unicode curly quotes (U+2018/U+2019) instead of ASCII apostrophes - PHP cannot use these as string delimiters, causing fatal syntax error on activation. 155 in class-email.php, 1 in class-settings.php.

entries.summary: Fix apostrophe in single-quoted string causing PHP syntax error in class-settings.php line 235
entries.notes: Contraction inside single quotes: previous smart-quote fix converted curly apostrophe to straight quote, which terminated the PHP string early. Changed to double-quoted string and replaced contraction with We will, removed exclamation point per writing style rules.

entries.summary: Add [oha_awards_landing] combined shortcode with two-card category chooser
entries.notes: New class-landing.php. Shows Haunt Actor and Campsite cards with open/closed state. ?award=actor or ?award=campsite switches to form view with back link. Cards use OHA Kadence palette vars and stack on mobile below 640px.

entries.summary: Add editable landing page text for both award types in Awards Settings
entries.notes: New settings fields actor_landing_text and campsite_landing_text in their respective sections. {year} placeholder replaced with active award year at render time. Defaults to built-in text if left blank.

entries.summary: Replace plain textarea with wp_editor for actor and campsite landing text fields in settings
entries.notes: Gives TinyMCE visual editor for both page text fields. Save side already used wp_kses_post so HTML was always allowed; this just makes it editable visually. Render side uses wpautop(wp_kses_post()) which handles both plain text and editor HTML correctly.

entries.summary: Add white border styles to all form inputs and textareas in oha-awards-form.css
entries.notes: Scoped to .oha-awards-form. Semi-transparent white border (rgba 255,255,255,0.55), slightly brighter on focus with faint glow. Also adds label styling and box-sizing:border-box. Applies to both actor and campsite submission forms.

entries.summary: Solid white input borders; fix campsite card text; add editable card descriptions in settings
entries.notes: Changed border from rgba(255,255,255,0.55) to solid #ffffff. Default campsite card text updated to "Submit your haunted campsite for recognition." New settings fields actor_card_text and campsite_card_text control the landing page card descriptions. Leave blank to use built-in defaults.

entries.summary: Replace "Please log in" text with embedded wp_login_form() on actor form and cert dashboard
entries.notes: class-frontend-form.php: login_form_html() helper wraps wp_login_form() in .oha-awards-login + .oha-awards-form div; redirects back to same page after login. class-shortcodes.php: same treatment for [oha_awards] cert dashboard. must_login() now redirects to wp_login_url instead of wp_die. Added input[type=password] to CSS border rules and .oha-awards-login block styles including OHA red submit button.

entries.summary: Add !important to form input border rules to override Kadence theme styles
entries.notes: Kadence theme has higher-specificity selectors (e.g. .entry-content input) that were overriding the white border. Added !important to border, border-radius, background, color, padding, box-sizing, width on .oha-awards-form inputs and textareas.

entries.summary: Broaden success notice selector so color applies outside .oha-awards-form wrapper
entries.notes: Notice in class-frontend-form.php renders before the form tag opens, so the old scoped selector never matched. New selector is .notice.notice-success (CSS only loads on awards pages via conditional enqueue).

entries.summary: Add inline color to cert dashboard success notice for pages where form CSS is not loaded
entries.notes: oha-awards-form.css is not enqueued on [oha_awards] cert dashboard pages. Inline color:#1a5218 ensures readable dark green text without relying on external CSS.

entries.summary: Login form inputs use white background and dark text on OHA dark background
entries.notes: wp_login_form() inputs inside .oha-awards-login were getting the dark theme styles from the global .oha-awards-form rule. New rule at .oha-awards-login .oha-awards-form overrides with white bg and dark text.

entries.summary: Style nomination submit button with OHA red background and white text
entries.notes: button[type=submit] inside .oha-awards-form now gets --global-palette1 red background, white text, and red hover state. Targets both actor and campsite submission forms.
